MedChatBot can be used for the following: (i) To provide a platform for the students to learn and understand the medical terms and their usage in the medical context, (ii) To help the student to get the answers for the questions related to medical domain, (iii) To provide the student with an opportunity to learn and improve their knowledge about the medical terms and (iv) To provide the opportunity for the students to interact with the chatbot and to learn about medical terms.

the use of natural dialog in tutoring systems is feasible.
a chatbot based on UMLS knowledge base can be used to provide medical information to students.
the use of a knowledge base such as UMLS can provide a robust and scalable knowledge base for chatbots, that can be used in a variety of applications.
